checkpoint_comparison.caption: Selected MMLU/MMLU-Pro questions, zero-shot forced-letter scoring. Unadjusted source/domain-stratified intervals; not official benchmark scores.

reconstruction_interactions.caption: Paired 95% bootstrap intervals are unadjusted. Read the table for declared-family Holm p values. Imperfect controls prevent semantic-specialization claims.

causal_effects.caption: Paired 95% bootstrap intervals are unadjusted. Read the table for declared-family Holm p values. Imperfect controls prevent semantic-specialization claims.

answer_label_effects.caption: Paired 95% bootstrap intervals are unadjusted. Read the table for exploratory-family Holm p values across twelve answer-label tests. Imperfect controls prevent semantic-specialization claims.

expert_norm_changes.caption: Same token positions, model-specific incoming hidden states. Each document's expert norms are divided by their mean before the paired log ratio. This measures magnitude, not function direction or causal necessity.

format_effects.caption: Exploratory protocol follow-up selected after the plain-prompt comparison. Paired unadjusted 95% intervals. The checkpoint and response-label strings are held fixed; routing and span loss use identical contiguous question tokens.
